metadata.title: Product Bricks
metadata.description: High-level brick map of the Katapull Commerce Hub: one brick per Katapull platform (each detailed in its own productscape) plus two group-level hub bricks. Brick dependencies show the integrations between platforms, labelled Documented, Partner listing or Inferred.

rootGroups.name: Commerce Hub Foundation
rootGroups.description: Group-level bricks that make the platforms work as one chain for shared customers.

bricks.name: Commerce Hub Bridges and Connection Registry
bricks.description: Group-level layer for the productised connections between Katapull platforms. Today the bridges live inside each brand (DeliveryMatch and Picqer "Katapull Commerce Hub Bridges", Transus "Katapull Commerce Hub Connectors", Logic4 "Public API and Katapull Integration Hub", Vendit "Partner Integration Gateway"). A shared registry, common account linking and event routing are an inference from the group's stated end-to-end ambition, not a published product.
